# Call setup failures and dropped calls in the South region

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `S-SUD-002`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct evidence of configuration changes preceding KPI degradation, aligned timing, and subsequent recovery upon rollback.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-26 11:45 to 2026-09-26 21:35
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-26 11:49
- **Affected:** S-SUD-002, S-SUD-008

## Summary

Scheduled parameter optimization batch OPT-17 applied via configuration changes CHG-2026-0065 and CHG-2026-0066 caused call setup failures and high drop rates on affected sites.

Call setup failures and high drop rates affected sites S-SUD-002 and S-SUD-008 starting at 2026-09-26 11:45 and ending at 21:35.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-26 11:45: Alert ALR-0032 started, indicating traffic, availability and RRC success drops. [ALR-0032]
- 2026-09-26 11:49: Configuration changes CHG-2026-0065 and CHG-2026-0066 applied to sites. [CHG-2026-0065, CHG-2026-0066]
- 2026-09-26 12:09: Alarm ALM-000452 raised for high RRC failure rate on S-SUD-008. [ALM-000452]
- 2026-09-26 21:35: Alarm ALM-000452 cleared following configuration rollbacks. [ALM-000452, CHG-2026-0065, CHG-2026-0066]

## Evidence

- Alert ALR-0032 began at 2026-09-26 11:45 across S-SUD-001, S-SUD-002, S-SUD-003, and S-SUD-008. [ALR-0032]
- Changes CHG-2026-0065 and CHG-2026-0066 were applied at 2026-09-26 11:49. [CHG-2026-0065, CHG-2026-0066]
- Alarm ALM-000452 was raised on S-SUD-008 at 2026-09-26 12:09 and cleared at 21:35. [ALM-000452]
- No external events were recorded for region SUD between 2026-09-26 06:00 and 13:00. [T11]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected sites during the incident window. [T7]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at S-SUD-002: confirmed. Configuration changes directly preceded KPI degradations and clearing occurred upon rollback. [CHG-2026-0065, CHG-2026-0066, ALM-000452]
2. **transport_failure** at LNK-SUD-01-A: rejected. No critical alarms or major transport layer degradations were found. [T3, T9]

## Ruled out

- T7: Maintenance check confirmed no maintenance windows were scheduled.
- T11: External events check confirmed no external events occurred in the region.

## Recommended actions

- Verify parameter batch OPT-17 templates before future deployments.
- Review change management validation steps for regional configuration pushes.

truth.notes: trap=bad_change_loud_coincidence; A scheduled parameter optimisation batch pushed to the 2 sites of LNK-SUD-01-B regressed RRC success and drop rate until it was rolled back. Root cause node is the first site of the pushed group. Trap: the change record looks innocent, and a louder, unrelated planned-maintenance outage on the sibling link LNK-SUD-01-A overlaps in time and draws the attention. Settled by: (1) the regression starts at the change time, before the maintenance window opens, on exactly the pushed sites, which keep 100 % availability while the sites of LNK-SUD-01-A are down; (2) it carries on after the window closes and ends at the rollback.
